case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Stadler,

Your offer speaks of a reliable delivery service and a lasting relationship, and that is exactly what we want to build on. Our options bring your plant a binding volume on top of what you supply to us today, spread over a long contract term, so the load stays steady.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On our past orders:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.20; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.17; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: it gives your plant the binding volume over the full term, and the long-standing price stability on both parts shows that the price we propose is one our two family companies can carry together.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As this goes beyond a normal price round, please take Option A to the colleague who decides on your side; we hope it makes that decision an easy one.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your proposal and the historical data; however, please note that some of the cited records do not directly apply to this specific bundled kit. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

We are willing to accommodate your preference for a 36-month contract and a 90-day payment term as outlined in your Option A. For this package, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 5.63. 

Our Angebot is a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 90 days net: €5.63 per unit. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Stadler,

You asked which volume we can commit to, and the options below answer that: every one of them carries a binding volume, business on top of what you supply to us today, so your plant gets steady load over a long contract term.

On the washer price:
Our orders of Washer ISO 7089 M12, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2024-10-10 (po:4500011536-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2025-06-11 (po:4500012581-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-01-29 (po:4500013501-10) and EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-20): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.20; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.22; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.26; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it gives you the binding volume and the long term you asked for, and it settles the price on a footing that has stayed stable between our two companies.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since price changes may need sign-off on your side, please take Option A to the person who decides. For them it is simple: a binding volume for the whole contract term, added to your current business with us, and a steady load for your plant. That is a fair solution for both family companies.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. While we have verified the historical data for the washer, it does not change our calculation for this specific bundled kit. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. 

We welcome your commitment to a binding volume of 30,000 units per year, which allows us to adjust our pricing. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

Our offer is a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. To confirm the terms of your Option A (45 days net payment, 36-month contract), we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 5.55 with an alternative package of a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
